text: I feel empty most of the time.
Nothing seems to make me happy anymore.
I have lost interest in the things I used to enjoy.
I feel emotionally drained every day.
Getting out of bed feels difficult.
I don't have the energy to do simple tasks.
I feel hopeless about my future.
Everything feels meaningless lately.
I feel like I'm just going through the motions.
I don't enjoy spending time with anyone anymore.
I feel disconnected from everyone around me.
I cry without knowing the exact reason.
I constantly feel sad even when nothing is wrong.
My motivation has completely disappeared.
I feel tired emotionally all the time.
I find it difficult to concentrate on my studies.
I don't feel excited about anything anymore.
Every day feels exactly the same.
I feel lonely even when I'm surrounded by people.
I feel like I've lost a part of myself.
